title: Editor does not keep information about metadata or type of objects inherited by `PackedScene`
body:
Loosely related to:
- #101287
- #76366

### Tested versions

v4.7.1.stable.custom_build [a13da4feb]

### System information

Godot v4.7.1.stable (a13da4feb) - 'Gentoo' '2.18' on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 3 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 (nvidia; 595.84) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.54 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Currently in Godot you can save metadatas and extend `PackedScene` and save them in a binary format trough code, you will also be able to load them trough code.

If you use  https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/122180
you will be able to save and load also text files. However...

In current stable, if you open a scene with custom data, the editor will remove that data after you save the scene. The same happens with text files in my PRs.

### Steps to reproduce

Have the following scripts:

custom_scene.gd
```gdscript
@tool
class_name CustomScene
extends PackedScene

@export_storage var inner_scene: PackedScene
```
test.gd
```gdscript
@tool
class_name Test
extends Node

const SCENE_BINARY = "res://scene_binary.res"
# const SCENE_TEXT = "res://scene_text.tscn"

@export_tool_button("Save Scene") var save_scene_action = store_new
@export_tool_button("Load Scene") var load_scene_action = load_saved


func store_new() -> void:
	var scene := CustomScene.new()
	scene.set_meta("TEST_META", "TEST_META_VALUE")

	var outer_node := Node.new()
	outer_node.name = "Outer"
	scene.pack(outer_node)

	ResourceSaver.save(scene, SCENE_BINARY)
	# ResourceSaver.save(scene, SCENE_TEXT)

func validate_scene(curr_scene):
	assert(curr_scene)

	var instanced_binary = curr_scene.instantiate()

	if instanced_binary.name == "Outer":
		print("Correct name")
	else:
		printerr("Invalid name")

	if curr_scene.get_meta("TEST_META", "") == "TEST_META_VALUE":
		print("Correct metadata")
	else:
		printerr("Invalid metadata")

	if curr_scene is CustomScene:
		print("Correct type")
	else:
		printerr("Invalid type")

func load_saved() -> void:
	var loaded_scene_binary = ResourceLoader.load(SCENE_BINARY)
	validate_scene(loaded_scene_binary)

	# var loaded_scene_text: CustomScene = ResourceLoader.load(SCENE_TEXT)
	# validate_scene(loaded_scene_text)


```
Uncomment all lines if you wish to test with my PR. In current stable text scenes will error in everything.

And then to reproduce the issue follow the steps:
1. Add the custom node `Test` to any scene after saving the scripts above. (or download the MRP and open main.tscn)
2. Select it and click in "Save Scene" in the inspector
3. Click immediately in "Load Scene" the console will print:
```
Correct name
Correct metadata
Correct type
```
4. Open the saved scene in the editor.
5. Press Ctrl+S, you don't have to change anything in the scene
6. Go back to previous scene, click in the node Test.
7. Click in Load Scene again without saving. The console will print:
```
Correct name
ERROR: Invalid metadata
ERROR: Invalid type
```
